throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 9 to 16 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 16383/3.

notes: Latency model: the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle on every element width and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 16.99 when the quotient is 0, 29 when it fits in four bits, otherwise 29 + 4 * floor(bits(quotient)/4); for h elements the quotient is at most 16 bits, so the maximum is 45. The remainder path costs one extra cycle in the general case and keeps the same extremes pattern, reaching 45. Measured with a calibrated reset chain (closure 8 cycles) on the maximum-latency operand pair; 1000-unroll slope method. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
